Literary Festivals Held Across India

Multiple literary festivals are scheduled to take place across India. The Jaipur Literature Festival is set to celebrate its twentieth anniversary in January 2027. Separately, the Odisha Literary Festival 2026 has commenced. During the Odisha event, Arif Mohammad Khan stated that literature provides emotional and spiritual comfort.
